versions.changelog:
Initial release: Practical, hands-on skill set for safe physical caregiving.

- Teaches essential body mechanics to prevent caregiver injury.
- Step-by-step instructions for safe transfers (bed to chair, standing assistance).
- Includes guidance on using gait belts and recognizing when to seek help.
- Covers region-specific healthcare and caregiver support details.
- Provides trusted sources for further information and skill verification.
